co_factor.detail: On this host, think=false with format=json often yields empty or garbage message.content for gpt-oss:20b even at num_predict=1024. think=true populates message.thinking (telemetry) and valid JSON in message.content. Primary classification remains truncation-by-reasoning-budget for the historical width 4/8 refusals measured with the prior 64-token cap.
co_factor.name: think_false_empties_gpt_oss_content
co_factor.repair: think=true shared by both arms; content-only answer channel unchanged

historical_refusal_interpretation.statement: All-cells-fail-JSON refusals at width 8 and width 4 were caused by this generation budget, not by memory, compute, or concurrency. Width 8 showed 41 GB peak resident and zero pageouts. Those receipts do not establish computational inadmissibility at either width.

host_measurement.why_256_insufficient: reasoning length scales with task complexity; observed max eval_count 375 for valid JSON

mechanism: gpt-oss:20b is a reasoning model. Ollama returns message.thinking and message.content separately. The adapter correctly reads content only, but reasoning tokens are charged against num_predict. With num_predict=64 (and 128, 256), eval_count exhausts on thinking and content is empty, so JSON parse fails for every cell.

model.note: reasoning model; Ollama returns message.thinking and message.content separately

repair_direction.justification: 1024 covers observed max eval_count 375 with headroom; 64 remains the frozen substantive payload bound
